prov.heading: Provision for Credit Losses
prov.text: For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, provisions for credit losses on loans totaling $66 thousand, and $16 thousand on held to maturity securities, offset by a recovery for unfunded loan commitments of $82 thousand, resulted in a net provision of $0. For the nine months ended September 30, 2025, provisions for credit losses on loans totaled $622 thousand and a provision for held to maturity securities of $19 thousand, offset by a recovery for unfunded loan commitments of $46 thousand, resulted in a net provision of $595.

nonint.heading: Noninterest Expense
nonint.text: Noninterest expense for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 totaled $14.6 million compared to $13.6 million for the same period of 2025, an increase of $917 thousand, or 6.7%. The increase was due primarily to an increase of $730 thousand in salaries and employee benefits due to higher staffing levels and benefits in 2026, and increase in ATM expenses of $86 thousand and an increase of $153 thousand in furniture and equipment expense due to an increase in software maintenance costs, offset by a decrease in professional fees of $54 thousand and a decrease of $188 thousand in Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation assessments resulting from lower brokered CD levels.

nonop.heading: Noninterest Expense
nonop.text: Noninterest expense for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 totaled $14.6 million compared to $13.6 million for the same period of 2025, an increase of $917 thousand, or 6.7%. The increase was due primarily to an increase of $730 thousand in salaries and employee benefits due to higher staffing levels and benefits in 2026, and increase in ATM expenses of $86 thousand and an increase of $153 thousand in furniture and equipment expense due to an increase in software maintenance costs, offset by a decrease in professional fees of $54 thousand and a decrease of $188 thousand in Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation assessments resulting from lower brokered CD levels.

net.text: Net income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was $5.7 million compared to $4.1 million for the same period of 2025. Total interest income increased by $2.6 million, from $31.1 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 to $33.7 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. Total interest expense decreased by $283 thousand, from $13.3 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 to $13.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. The provision for credit losses for the nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025 was $0 and $595 thousand, respectively. Noninterest income remained consistent at $1.5 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 and 2026. Noninterest expense increased by $917 thousand, from $13.6 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 to $14.6 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. Income tax expense increased by $835 thousand, from $1.1 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 to $1.9 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.

Net interest income.heading: Net Interest Income
Net interest income.text:
Net interest income was $20.7 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $17.8 million for the same period of 2025. The net yield on interest earning assets increased to 3.32% for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 from 2.98% for the same period of 2025. Higher interest income on loans was the driving factor in the higher net interest income.

Total interest income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was $33.7 million compared to $31.1 million for the same period of 2025, an increase of $2.6 million, or 8.3%.

Total interest income on loans for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 increased by $2.9 million when compared to the same period of 2025 due to a $29.0 million higher average loan balance for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 when compared to the same period of 2025 and a higher loan yield of 6.14% for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 versus 5.79% for the same period of 2025. Investment income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 decreased by $728 thousand, or 24.5%, when compared to the same period of 2025 due to a decrease in the fully-taxable equivalent yield to 2.63% for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to 3.02% for the same period of 2025, and a $14.7 million lower average investment balance.

Noninterest income.heading: Noninterest Income
Noninterest income.text: Noninterest income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 was $1.5 million. There were no significant changes in the categories comprising noninterest income.

intro.text: Farmers and Merchants Bancshares, Inc. is a Maryland corporation chartered on August 8, 2016 that is registered with the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (the “Federal Reserve”) as a bank holding company under the Bank Holding Company Act of 1956, as amended (the “BHC Act”). At the time it registered as a bank holding company, the Company also elected to become a financial holding company, which allows it to engage in certain activities, and own shares or control of certain entities, that are in addition to those permissible for an entity that is a bank holding company only. Effective November 1, 2016, the Company consummated a bank holding company reorganization involving Farmers and Merchants Bank (the “Bank”) pursuant to which the Bank became a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company and all of the Bank’s stockholders became stockholders of the Company.
